# Європейська правда (European Pravda)

> > Ukrainian news portal covering European integration, NATO membership, U.S. foreign policy, and international relations with focus on Ukraine's path to EU and NATO.

Європейська правда (European Pravda) is a leading Ukrainian news source providing comprehensive coverage of Ukraine's European and Euro-Atlantic integration, diplomatic relations with the United States, EU, NATO, and coverage of key political figures including Donald Trump, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Viktor Orban, and Emmanuel Macron. The site focuses on geopolitical developments affecting Ukraine's sovereignty and international partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Ukraine-EU Integration
- NATO Membership
- U.S. Foreign Policy
- Hungary-Ukraine Relations
- Orban Veto
- Volodymyr Zelenskyy
- Donald Trump
- Viktor Orban
- Emmanuel Macron
- European Union
- Geopolitics
- Iran Conflict
- Russia
- Peter Szijjártó
- Pete Hegseth

## Main Portal

- [Європейська правда: Трамп та дії США, вступ України до ЄС та НАТО. Головні новини](https://www.eurointegration.com.ua): Homepage: Ukrainian news on EU, NATO, Trump, Zelenskyy, Orban & international relations
